No `vcs detect/push/branch/ci` mention is left in src or docs apart from the history paragraph at docs/commit-authorship.md:9.
- hook subagent-start: the payload is decoded with Payload (Schema.fromJsonString). The hook emits {hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:'SubagentStart',additionalContext}} only when agent_type starts with 'holyagent:' and is not the root. Nothing is emitted for 'holyagent', 'holyagent:holyagent', 'general-purpose', 'Explore', 'other:worker' or a missing type. The text is the specialist state-changes.md imported as text, so it has one owner and a test asserts it equals the section embedded in the agent prompt. A bad payload gives exit 1 with one stderr line and no stdout. hooks.json wires no onFailure, and exit 2 is never produced. I ran the built dist and got the expected shape.
- hook vcs-reminder: only PreToolUse additionalContext, never a permission decision. A non-string command, another tool, or a command without git followed by commit or push yields nothing. Behavior I could only read, not run: that Claude Code 2.1.x delivers SubagentStart additionalContext to the subagent and matches the plugin agent_type as 'holyagent:<agent>'. Tests use a synthetic payload.
- shell.ts removal is clean: no import of it, gitWrites or vcs-redirect remains in src, tests, dist or docs (the only 'vcs-redirect' hit is the test that proves the hook is gone, hooks.test.ts:230). The lint and type-check pass. docs/hooks.md ('five hooks on four events') matches hooks.json. vcs exposes exactly `vcs commit` and `vcs pr` (commands.ts:45 and 89; vcs --help lists only those two).
- hook commit-msg now also cleans attribution below the scissors line and reads comment settings only from the repository's files, not from -c or GIT_CONFIG_*. Both are tested (hooks.test.ts:356 and 366), and the effects are small. Optional (scope): this goes beyond replacing the guard, and the hardening against a caller hiding text sits oddly with the rationale that text-reading cannot stop a determined bypass. I would not block on it.
- Optional: vcs-reminder fires on every legitimate root `git push` or `git commit`, including a plain push, because the match is on the words. This adds one line of context per push. It is intended by the decision, but it is noise for the root.
- Optional (carried): ROOT_CORE is 3999 characters against the 4000 cap, so the next edit to a core file fails the test. The instruction changes this round net to roughly zero characters, so the margin did not worsen.
- Not run: Claude Code itself with the plugin loaded (so no end-to-end delivery of the SubagentStart context), lefthook, and anything against GitHub.
